title: In Cold Blood
author: Truman Capote
summary: Truman Capote reconstructs the 1959 murder of the Clutter family in rural Kansas, and the investigation and trial of the two men who killed them. It reads like a novel but is built from his reporting.
readIf: you want a classic of true crime written with a novelist's eye.
skipIf: you want a fast whodunit, since the killers are known early and the focus is on them.
